His career is just getting started, and he's taken the snowboard world by storm. From placing 1st at the Sim's World Championship in Vail, Colorado, to the new car he won in the Toyota Big Air in Japan (he didn't even have a driver's license yet), to winning the most prestigious "Arctic Challenge" in Norway - White is becoming a household name all over the world. Now at the age of 17, after 12 podium parking spots last season, White has grown into the big boy style and the veterans are a little concerned about the "Flying Tomato." He's highly respected by his peers, extremely talented, and has a long, prosperous career ahead.

Title: Cheonhajangsa madonna
Stars: Lee Hae-young, Baek Yoon-shik, Lee Sang-ah, Eon Lee
Description: OH Dong-gu believes himself to be female. Although overweight and on the short side, he dreams of becoming perfect some day, and devotes himself to mimicking Madonna's singing and dancing after school. To cover the costs of transsexual surgery, he decides to enter a wrestling competition.

Title: Skaterdater
Stars: Michael Mel, Melissa Mallory, Gregg Carroll
Description: A group of young boys show their skateboarding skills around town, trying to impress each other. One boy keeps crashing into the girl on a bike so they decide to hang out instead. His friends don't understand his budding romance.

Title: Snow Summit Showdown
Stars: Colin Paradine, Brad Siciliano, Meredith Heinrich
Description: A Christmas adventure in Snow Summit.

Title: Truth in Motion: The US Ski Team's Road to Vancouver
Stars: Thomas Mikal Ford, Ted Ligety, Scott Macartney

Title: The Search for Animal Chin
Stars: Chris Borst, Steve Caballero, Adrian Demain
Description: The Bones Brigade skate their way across America in search of legendary skater, Won Ton Animal Chin. The missing skater remains elusive, but the crew journey from Hawaii to Vegas and realise that Animal Chin is alive in them all.

Title: How to Be Ridiculous
Stars: Julian Lowenthal

Title: Vsyo reshayet mgnoveniye
Stars: Galina Belyaeva, Olga Ageyeva, Boris Seidenberg
Description: The story of a Russian record-breaking female swimmer, Nadya Privalova, who suffered from a stage fright syndrome.

Title: Popcorn und Paprika
Stars: Siegfried Rauch, John Jürgens, Jenny Jürgens
Description: The German national swim team is on their way to an international contest against Hungary. A busload of young kids is looking forward to a week of fun in the "Paris of the East". But when top swimmer Peter falls in love with a Hungarian girl, Sigi, the coach knows that he's heading for trouble.

Title: Sarahsarà
Stars: Kim Engelbrecht, Giulio Brogi, Ciro Esposito
Description: Inspired by the true story of Sarah Gadalla Gubara. In Namibia, Africa, Gershe, a reporter whose car has broken down, is almost killed by a passing ambulance. After following it into the hospital, he witnesses the drama of two Indian immigrants, Vernon and Karima, whose little daughter Sarah, will remain limping for life. Ten years later, Sarah has turned into an excellent swimmer. After she wins second place in the school trials in Cape Town, her parents decides to look for a trainer. Sarah's life crosses paths again with Gershe, the reporter, who was a swimming instructor in the past. Although initially skeptical, he finally agrees to train the young Sara. Sara find a new friend, Ciro, who takes care of the reporter and run the car repair shop he inherited from his own father after his death. In time of the most important national trial, Sara's father, Vernon, was killed in a robbery attempt. Sarah succeed in turning her dream into reality: participating in the Italian, Capri-Napoli marathon, a swimming race of 35km in open seas.

Title: Einfache Leute
Stars: Barbara Auer, Klaus J. Behrendt, Oliver Breite
Description: A Boy has to decide between being gay and being a professional swimmer. He takes the latter, marries and gets a son. 19 years later the whole thing explodes.

Title: Joshikyôei hanrangun
Stars: Sasa Handa, Yuria Hidaka, Ayumu Tokitô
Description: The new girl at school helps the swim team battle their infected teachers and classmates.

Title: Le monde du silence
Stars: Louis Malle, Frédéric Dumas, Albert Falco, Jacques-Yves Cousteau
Description: A documentary about the undersea explorers and how they penetrate into the underwater world.

Title: Le monde sans soleil
Stars: André Folco, Pierre Guilbert, Raymond Kientzy
Description: Fascinating underwater documentary filmed with hand-held cameras by frogmen and mostly filmed in deep-water seas from within a special designed batiscaff, by the Cousteau family of sea explorers.

Title: 크리드
Stars: Michael B. Jordan, Sylvester Stallone, Tessa Thompson
Description: The former World Heavyweight Champion Rocky Balboa serves as a trainer and mentor to Adonis Johnson, the son of his late friend and former rival Apollo Creed.

Title: The Big Green
Stars: Steve Guttenberg, Olivia d'Abo, Jay O. Sanders
Description: A teacher on exchange from England is placed in an underachieving Texas school, where she coaches the students in soccer, improving their self-esteem and leading to unexpected success.

Title: Happy Valley
Stars: Joe Paterno, Jay Paterno, Andrew Shubin
Description: A documentary that observes the year after Pennsylvania State University assistant football coach Jerry Sandusky's arrest on child sex-abuse charges.

Title: Two Days in April
Stars: Bruce Allen, Tom Condon, Chuck Cook
Description: Follows the story of 4 college football players signed by the sports agency IMG, as they bring them to a training facility in Florida and both physically and mentally prepare them for the NFL draft.

Title: Andre the Giant
Stars: Robin Wright, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Cary Elwes
Description: A look at the life and career of professional wrestler André Roussimoff, who gained notoriety in the 1980s as Andre the Giant.

Title: Borg
Stars: Sverrir Gudnason, Shia LaBeouf, Stellan Skarsgård
Description: The story of the 1980 tennis rivalry between the placid Björn Borg and the volatile John McEnroe.

Title: Race
Stars: Stephan James, Jason Sudeikis, Eli Goree
Description: Jesse Owens' quest to become the greatest track and field athlete in history thrusts him onto the world stage of the 1936 Olympics, where he faces off against Adolf Hitler's vision of Aryan supremacy.

Title: Kobe Doin' Work
Stars: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Stephen A. Smith, Kobe Bryant
Description: A documentary following Kobe Bryant during one day during a game against the San Antonio Spurs.

Title: 100 Years of the World Series
Stars: Hank Aaron, Grover Cleveland Alexander, Maury Allen

Title: 마이클 조던: 더 라스트 댄스
Stars: Phil Jackson, Scottie Pippen
Description: Led by Michael Jordan, the 1990s Chicago Bulls establish themselves as one of the most notable dynasties in sports history.

Title: McFarland, USA
Stars: Kevin Costner, Ramiro Rodriguez, Carlos Pratts
Description: Jim White moves his family after losing his last job as a football coach, and at his new school he turns seven disappointing students into one of the best cross-country teams in the region.

Title: Sunderland 'Til I Die
Stars: Nick Barnes, Aiden McGeady
Description: Highlights the unfailing passion Sunderland residents have for their beloved football club, taking viewers through the highs and lows of SAFC's 2017-18 season in the Championship following its relegation the previous year.

Title: Pelé
Stars: David Tryhorn, Pelé, Muhammad Ali, Amarildo
Description: Looks back at the extraordinary 12-year period in which Pelé, the only man to win three World Cup titles, went from young superstar in 1958 to national hero in 1970; a radical yet turbulent era in Brazil’s history.

Title: Killer Inside: The Mind of Aaron Hernandez
Stars: Kevin Armstrong, Dan Wetzel
Description: A three-part documentary series examining what led to the murderous fall and shocking death of former NFL superstar Aaron Hernandez.

Title: Untold
Stars: Rafer Alston, Tom Austin, Seth Berger
Description: Inspired by New York City streetball, influential brand AND1 turned local legends on the court into international icons. So why did it come to an end?

Title: Last Chance U: Basketball
Stars: Dezmond Washington, Rob Robinson
Description: Explore an honest and gritty look inside the world of community college basketball.

Title: 슈마허
Stars: Vanessa Nöcker, Michael Wech, Ross Brawn, Flavio Briatore, David Coulthard
Description: Through exclusive interviews and archival footage, this documentary traces an intimate portrait of seven-time Formula 1 champion Michael Schumacher.

Title: No No: A Dockumentary
Stars: Enos Cabell, Dave Cash, Roberto Clemente Jr.
Description: The life and times of major league pitcher Dock Ellis are explored in this revealing documentary.

Title: 배드 스포츠: 조작된 승부
Stars: Hansie Cronje, Kent Somers
Description: Follows six stories of sports and crime, told by the athletes, coaches and law enforcement officials.

Title: Team Foxcatcher
Stars: John du Pont, Dave Schultz, Mike Gostigian
Description: Documentary filmmaker Jon Greenhalgh examines the life of Dave Schultz, a professional wrestler who was part of 'Team Foxcatcher', funded by multi-millionaire John du Pont.

Title: Air
Stars: Matt Damon, Jason Bateman, Ben Affleck
Description: The history of the game-changing partnership between a then undiscovered Michael Jordan and Nike's fledgling basketball division which revolutionized the world of sports and culture with the Air Jordan brand.

Title: Kelce
Stars: Jason Avant, Connor Barwin, Angelo Cataldi
Description: Highlights Jason Kelce's 2022-23 season, which started with him having to make one of the hardest decisions a professional athlete would ever have to make: Is it time to retire yet?

Title: Bye Bye Barry
Stars: Micaela Powers, Angela Torma, Barry Sanders, Troy Aikman, Tim Allen
Description: The definitive story of Barry Sanders' Hall-of-Fame career and his extraordinary decision to walk away from the game in the prime of his career.

Title: The Hill
Stars: Dennis Quaid, Colin Ford, Joelle Carter
Description: The true story of Rickey Hill, the son of a travelling pastor who overcomes physical obstacles to pursue his dream of playing baseball in the major leagues.

Title: Magic & Bird: A Courtship of Rivals
Stars: Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Steve Springer
Description: An exploration of the fierce rivalry between NBA superstars Larry Bird and Magic Johnson during their decade of dominance.

Title: Charlie Hustle & the Matter of Pete Rose
Stars: Jon Miller, C. Trent Rosecrans
Description: Chronicling baseball legend Pete Rose's career, rise to fame, scandals and bid for reinstatement, with archival footage and interviews exploring his contradictory persona as both a tenacious hustler and a fallen icon tainted by gambling.

Title: The Turnaround
Stars: Kyle Thrash, Jon McCann, Stewie the Dog, J.D. Drew
Description: Jon McCann, a Phillies fan from the city's Bridesburg neighborhood and a content creator known as "The Philly Captain" who helped spearhead the standing ovation.

Title: We Beat the Dream Team
Stars: Anthony Edwards, Grant Hill, Chris Webber
Description: The true behind-the-scenes story of the only game the 1992 United States men's Olympic basketball team lost, as told by the young college players who beat them.
